selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline: firewalld active/enabled, ssh reachable, existing rules observed
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed RHEL 10, firewalld active+enabled, default zone public with services cockpit/dhcpv6-client/ssh, sshd listening on 22.

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and tcp/8080
selected_evidence.summary: Removed cockpit, added 8080/tcp permanently, reloaded; runtime and permanent configs both show only dhcpv6-client+ssh services and 8080/tcp port.

selected_evidence.requirement: Firewall rejects unrelated inbound connections (kernel-level proof)
selected_evidence.summary: nft ruleset shows filter_INPUT falls through to 'reject with icmpx admin-prohibited' for unmatched traffic; filter_IN_public_allow only accepts tcp dport 22 and tcp dport 8080.

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional verification of 8080 reachability and limits of same-host testing
selected_evidence.summary: 8080 listener reachable via NODE_IP; 8081 also succeeded locally but `ip route get $NODE_IP` showed traffic to own IP resolves via local 'lo' route, bypassing the interface-scoped firewall rule -- explaining why 8081 wasn't blocked in this same-host test and why the nft ruleset inspection is the authoritative check. Temporary listeners cleaned up afterward.

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart baseline boot identity and service health
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 646e5f74-dc0e-45e7-9746-226c4351af28, firewalld enabled/active, sshd active.
systemctl reboot issued in background; exec call returned (stream closed) confirming the reboot command was accepted and executing.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node unreachable during restart, then recovered
selected_evidence.summary: Poll attempts show connection timeout, then connection reset, then successful command execution, demonstrating the node went down and came back up.

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proves an actual restart occurred
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id ee62de1b-6865-4f7a-b5bb-1fdd946f7560 differs from baseline 646e5f74-dc0e-45e7-9746-226c4351af28, with a fresh uptime timestamp.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of firewall rules and services
selected_evidence.summary: firewalld active/enabled, sshd active, and nft ruleset (filter_IN_public_allow) unchanged post-reboot: only tcp/22 and tcp/8080 accepted, confirming persistence across restart.
